text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for Klebsiella pneumoniae (>100,000 CFU/mL), consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria further support this. Glucosuria with normal ketones may warrant further evaluation for glycemic status. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
